test_scaled_position_actuator: test the scaled position actuator produces same torque as a standard actuator across random controls
test_scaled_velocity_actuator: test the scaled velocity actuator produces same torque as a standard actuator across random controls
test_invalid_kwargs_error: test that add_position_actuator raises TypeError when passed invalid keyword arguments like joint or ctrllimited
test_invalid_target_error: test that add_position_actuator raises TypeError when passed a non-joint target like a worldbody element
run_scaled_actuators_tests: run the absltest suite for scaled actuators to verify position and velocity actuator equivalence
